name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Log Size
details: For every finite binary class $\mathcal H$ with $\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)\geq2$, $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\geq\log_2|\mathcal H|/(2\log_2\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H))$.
proof: Put $d=\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)$ and $e=\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$. Remove constant-coordinate examples from an optimal teacher; this preserves every inconsistency between targets. Since $d\leq\lceil e/2\rceil\leq e$, pad each remaining sample to exactly $d$ effective coordinates with its target's labels. Padding cannot create a clash. Distinct targets receive distinct samples, so $|\mathcal H|\leq2^d\binom ed\leq(2e)^d$. Thus $d\geq\log_2|\mathcal H|/(1+\log_2 e)$; for $e\geq2$, using $1+\log_2 e\leq2\log_2 e$ gives the stated weaker bound.
proof_source: Proposition prop:nctd-low-log-size in the LaTeX survey.
